input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Developer roles. It manages core business objects including account, jwt user, statistic, travel. The platform provides capabilities for travels java a p i exception handler, account, account. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage account records, so that I can track and organize account data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage jwt user records, so that I can track and organize jwt user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage statistic records, so that I can track and organize statistic data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage travel records, so that I can track and organize travel data effectively.
